
FreeCAD Workbench: Part Design + A2Plus (Assembly)
Project Name: Custom Work Desk

Components:
1. Legs (4):
   - Profile: 40x40 mm square tube
   - Length: 71.5 cm
   - Features: 2 bolt holes on top and side (M8)

2. Long Beams (2):
   - Length: 160 cm
   - Profile: 40x40 mm
   - Features: Bolt holes on each end

3. Short Beams (2):
   - Length: 67 cm
   - Profile: 40x40 mm
   - Positioned between long beams

4. Crossbars (2-3):
   - Length: ~67 cm
   - Profile: 40x20 mm
   - Positioned front to back

5. Tabletop:
   - Size: 160 x 75 x 2.5 cm
   - Material: Wood (visual only in FreeCAD)

6. Assembly:
   - Bolted using A2Plus constraints
   - M8 bolts & washers positioned via Fasteners WB

Next Step:
1. Open FreeCAD.
2. Use the Part Design workbench to sketch and pad each component.
3. Save each as a separate part file.
4. Import all parts into an A2Plus Assembly.
5. Apply plane and concentric constraints.
